result.title: Hierarchical Diffusion Transformer for End-to-End Image Generation
result.summary: Pixel-space diffusion learns visual representations and image generation jointly in a single end-to-end training stage, without a separately pretrained visual encoder. However, plain pixel-space Transformers still trail leading two-stage latent diffusion models in generation quality and training efficiency. We hypothesize that part of this gap arises from retaining one token per patch throughout the backbone, which does not explicitly encourage a visual hierarchy that summarizes related content at progressively coarser levels. To address this, we introduce Hierarchical Diffusion Transformers (HiT), which progressively group related tokens and represent each group with a single token. The main Transformer bottleneck processes these compact group tokens, and ungrouping restores features to their original image positions. A compression budget regulates the average compression ratio across the batch, allowing group memberships and counts to vary across images and diffusion timesteps during both training and generation. The model exhibits emergent semantic structure, learning to group coherent objects and object parts without segmentation labels. In text-to-image generation, HiT further learns to group caption words with image patches depicting the same concepts, without region annotations. HiT achieves 1.48 FID on ImageNet $256\times256$ and reaches comparable generation quality to JiT using approximately 40\% of its cumulative training FLOPs. For text-to-image generation, HiT exceeds UniLiP's average score across five benchmarks with roughly $6\times$ fewer denoiser parameters and $3\times$ fewer forward FLOPs. These results suggest that learning a visual hierarchy within the generator breaks down the barrier to stronger image generation without external visual pretraining.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Hierarchical Diffusion Transformer（HiT），在像素空间扩散主干中按可学习的成员关系逐步把相关 patch token 归并为更粗粒度的组 token，用压缩预算控制平均压缩率，并证明分组能自发对应物体、部件及标题词与图像区域的对应。
AI.relevance_reason: 其无标注、随图像与扩散步自适应的 token 分组与压缩预算机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉状态的层级抽象、压缩率与细节保真之间的权衡提供可核查的表示构造思路，但论文本身面向图像生成，未涉及推理状态或答案使用。
